exact_statement: For any p in (0,1) and horizon T>0, the two-state reversible continuous-time Markov generators q(U,B)=a p and q(B,U)=a(1-p), a>0, all have stationary bound fraction p and identical equilibrium free-energy difference, while P(B at T | X_0=U)=p(1-exp(-aT)) ranges from 0 to p as a varies. Thus equilibrium energies alone do not determine a nontrivial finite-time response bound uniformly over detailed-balance kinetics.
assumptions: Transition rates are not supplied by the equilibrium energy landscape
novelty_boundary: The mathematical rate-scaling fact and finite-time two-state relaxation are standard; no novelty or priority claim. Primary riboswitch papers already distinguish affinity/equilibrium from rates and transcription timing.

costs.equilibrium_only: Requires energies or KD but cannot identify absolute response times
costs.kinetic_prediction: Requires absolute association/dissociation/folding rates and transcription decision-time or pause distribution

falsifier: No-go falsifier would require an additional supplied restriction linking equilibrium energies to a uniformly bounded kinetic timescale; none is part of the stated interface.
next_gate: For a named riboswitch, acquire same-condition rates and transcription timing, then test the finite-window prediction against direct transcript readthrough/termination.

exact_statement: Under a constant concentration c and a conditional first-capture hazard k_on*c while an unbound ligand-free trajectory is binding competent, the capture probability by decision is p(c)=1-E[exp(-k_on*c*A)], where A is the integrated competent-state exposure up to the actual transcription decision. For K prespecified sequences with n independent complete paths per sequence and known k_on,j, the empirical Laplace dose curves satisfy simultaneous coverage over all c>=0 and all sequences with probability at least 1-delta using half-width eps=sqrt(log(2K/delta)/(2n)).
assumptions: Until first capture, the concentration-c ligand-free conformational path has the same law as the measured path
Capture hazard is k_on,j*c on competent unbound states and zero elsewhere
Capture is absorbing for the output being predicted
For each fixed sequence, exposure traces are iid and complete through transcription decision
novelty_boundary: The conditional Poisson/Laplace identity and DKW inequality are standard mathematical tools. Bounded primary-literature search found no riboswitch paper using ligand-free per-path exposure to predict the full dose curve this way; priority is unverified.

costs.exposure: N_complete=K*ceil(log(2K/delta)/(2 eps^2)) complete ligand-free single-molecule transcription traces; at frame interval dt and horizon T, approximately N_complete*ceil(T/dt) frames
costs.rate: Acquire same-condition k_on for each sequence unless a validated common value is supplied; acquire k_off to test capture commitment
costs.measurement: State classification calibration and temporal-resolution/censoring bounds are additional systematic-error costs

falsifier: A held-out ligand concentration with measured capture/output outside the simultaneous band after certified rate, censoring, state-classification and exposure-discretization errors rejects the one-state absorbing first-capture model.
next_gate: Acquire complete trajectories for a small fixed sequence screen, freeze bands before measuring outcomes at held-out concentrations, compare with KD-only and a full multistate CTMC fit.

exact_statement: The integrated exposure A alone does not determine bound-at-decision probability when ligand dissociates: for early and late competent windows of equal duration T/2 with first-capture rate lambda and dissociation rate mu>0, P_late(bound at T)=exp(mu*T/2)*P_early(bound at T)>P_early(bound at T), despite identical A=T/2.
assumptions: Bound ligand dissociates at rate mu>0
No rebinding after dissociation outside the competent interval
novelty_boundary: A model counterexample, not a biological discovery. It demonstrates that the path-exposure theorem predicts first capture only unless irreversibility/commitment is established.

costs.needed_for_endpoint_prediction: Acquire k_off and state-specific post-binding/transcription-transition rates, or directly measure endpoint outcomes

falsifier: The caveat disappears only in the absorbing limit mu=0 or if any capture irreversibly commits the regulatory outcome before dissociation.
next_gate: Measure k_off and post-capture dwell/termination commitment in the exact construct and buffer used for exposure traces.
